theme: 教材字彙・高分 850–900 第 64 群

items.pos: adj. 附近的 | adv. 在附近
items.colloc: nearby location 鄰近地點 | nearby restaurant 附近餐廳
items.distinct: near 靠近（介系詞）| neighboring 鄰近的（形容詞）
ex: There is a nearby parking garage for clients.
客戶附近有一座停車場。
We stayed at a hotel located nearby.
我們住在附近的一家飯店。
Is there a reputable bank nearby?
附近有信譽良好的銀行嗎？

items.pos: adv. 整潔地；有序地
items.colloc: neatly arranged 整齊排列 | neatly organized 有條理的
items.distinct: tidy 整潔的（形容詞）| orderly 有秩序的
ex: All documents were neatly stacked on the desk.
所有文件都整齊地堆在桌上。
The employee keeps her workspace neatly organized.
那位員工將工作空間整理得井然有序。
Please pack the items neatly into boxes.
請將物品整齊地裝入箱子。

items.pos: adj. 相反的；對面的 | prep. 在…對面
items.colloc: opposite side 對面側 | opposite direction 相反方向
items.distinct: contrary 相反的（觀點）| across from 在…對面
ex: The office building is opposite the station.
辦公大樓就在車站對面。
They hold opposite views on the new policy.
他們對新政策持有相反看法。
He sat in the chair opposite me.
他坐在我對面的椅子上。

items.pos: adv. 大眾地；普遍地
items.colloc: popularly known 普遍被稱為 | popularly accepted 被廣泛接受
items.distinct: generally 通常地 | commonly 常見地
ex: This brand is popularly considered the market leader.
此品牌被大眾視為市場領導者。
The software is popularly used in the industry.
這套軟體在業界被普遍使用。
The event is popularly attended by local residents.
這項活動普遍受到當地居民參加。

items.pos: adj. 定價的
items.colloc: competitively priced 價格具有競爭力 | reasonably priced 合理定價
items.distinct: costly 昂貴的 | affordable 負擔得起的
ex: These high-quality goods are competitively priced.
這些高品質商品定價具有競爭力。
Our services are reasonably priced for startups.
我們的服務對新創公司來說定價合理。
The luxury watch is priced at five thousand.
那支名錶定價五千元。

items.pos: v. 追求；從事；追趕
items.colloc: pursue a career 追求事業 | pursue a goal 追求目標
items.distinct: chase 追逐（具體物件）| seek 尋求
ex: She wants to pursue a career in finance.
她想要追求金融界的事業。
The company will pursue new business opportunities.
公司將會追求新的商業機會。
We must pursue this matter further tomorrow.
我們明天必須進一步處理此事。

items.pos: prep. 關於；有關
items.colloc: regarding the matter 關於此事 | regarding your request 有關您的請求
items.distinct: concerning 涉及 | about 關於（較口語）
ex: I am writing regarding your recent inquiry.
我寫這封信是關於您最近的諮詢。
There is no change regarding the schedule.
關於行程表沒有任何變動。
Please provide instructions regarding the project.
請提供有關該專案的指示。

items.pos: adj. 粗略的；艱難的；粗糙的
items.colloc: rough draft 草稿 | rough estimate 粗略估計
items.distinct: tough 困難的（形容人或物堅韌）| coarse 粗糙的（表面）
ex: Can you provide a rough estimate of costs?
你能提供粗略的成本估算嗎？
The team faced a rough start this year.
團隊今年面臨了艱難的開始。
Please prepare a rough draft for approval.
請準備一份草稿以供批准。

items.pos: adv. 例行地；慣常地
items.colloc: routinely check 例行檢查 | routinely perform 例行執行
items.distinct: regularly 定期地 | constantly 持續地
ex: Technicians routinely check the server status.
技術人員會例行檢查伺服器狀態。
We routinely review our quarterly performance.
我們慣常檢視每季的業績。
Data is routinely backed up every evening.
資料每天晚上都會例行備份。

items.pos: adj. 明智的；合理的；實用的
items.colloc: sensible decision 明智的決定 | sensible approach 合理的方法
items.distinct: sensitive 敏感的 | sensible 明智的
ex: It is a sensible idea to diversify investments.
分散投資是明智的想法。
The manager made a sensible choice today.
經理今天做了一個明智的選擇。
We need a sensible solution to this problem.
我們需要針對此問題提出合理的解決方案。

items.pos: n. 袖子；封套
items.colloc: long sleeve 長袖 | protective sleeve 保護套
items.distinct: cuff 袖口 | collar 衣領
ex: The formal shirt has long sleeves.
這件正式襯衫有長袖。
Please put the document in a plastic sleeve.
請將文件放入塑膠封套中。
The design features unique sleeve patterns.
該設計採用獨特的袖子紋樣。

items.pos: n. 斜坡；傾斜 | v. 傾斜
items.colloc: steep slope 陡坡 | slope down 向下傾斜
items.distinct: hill 小山 | ramp 斜坡道（人造）
ex: The factory is built on a gentle slope.
這座工廠建在緩坡上。
The ground begins to slope toward the river.
地面開始向河流方向傾斜。
Construction is difficult on such a steep slope.
在這種陡坡上施工很困難。

items.pos: adj. 站立的；長期有效的 | n. 地位；身分
items.zh: 站立的；長期有效的；地位
items.colloc: standing ovation 起立鼓掌 | standing order 常設訂單
items.distinct: stationary 靜止的 | state 身分
ex: There is a standing meeting every Friday.
每個星期五都有例行會議。
She has high standing within the company.
她在公司內擁有很高的地位。
The candidate received a standing ovation.
那位候選人贏得了起立鼓掌。

items.pos: n. 溪流；流；串流 | v. 流動；串流播放
items.colloc: live stream 直播 | revenue stream 收入來源
items.distinct: river 河流 | flow 流動（動詞為主）
ex: The company needs a new revenue stream.
公司需要新的收入來源。
We will live stream the product launch.
我們將直播產品發布會。
Data continues to stream into the system.
資料持續流入系統中。

items.pos: adj. 甜的；貼心的 | n. 甜點
items.colloc: sweet treat 甜點心 | sweet gesture 貼心的舉動
items.distinct: sugary 含糖的 | kind 友善的
ex: The offer included a sweet bonus package.
這份錄取信包含貼心的額外福利。
Employees enjoyed some sweet treats during break.
員工在休息時間享用了一些甜點。
That was a sweet note from the client.
那是來自客戶貼心的短訊。

items.pos: n. 陷阱 | v. 困住；設陷阱
items.colloc: set a trap 設陷阱 | fall into a trap 掉入陷阱
items.distinct: pitfall 隱藏的困難 | snare 圈套
ex: Don't fall into the trap of overspending.
不要掉入過度消費的陷阱。
The worker was trapped in the elevator.
那位員工被困在電梯裡。
We must avoid traps in the contract.
我們必須避開合約中的條款陷阱。

items.pos: n. 曲調；和諧 | v. 調音；調整
items.colloc: tune in 收聽/收看 | stay in tune 與…保持一致
items.distinct: adjust 調整（設備）| harmonize 使和諧
ex: We need to tune our strategy to the market.
我們需要根據市場調整策略。
Please tune in to our weekly podcast.
請準時收聽我們的每週廣播。
The guitar was out of tune for the performance.
那把吉他演出時音準不對。

items.pos: v. 警告；告誡
items.colloc: warn of 警告關於 | warn against 告誡不要
items.distinct: alert 提醒；警示 | caution 謹慎（名詞/動詞）
ex: The sign warns of slippery floor conditions.
告示牌警告地板濕滑。
He warned his team against late submissions.
他告誡團隊不要遲交文件。
I must warn you about the potential risks.
我必須警告你關於潛在的風險。

items.pos: adv. 大體上；廣泛地
items.colloc: broadly speaking 大體上來說 | broadly defined 廣義定義
items.distinct: widely 廣泛地（範圍大）| generally 通常地
ex: Broadly speaking, the project is successful.
大體上來說，這個專案是成功的。
The term is broadly defined in this document.
該術語在此文件中被廣泛定義。
They agree broadly on the main objectives.
他們大體上同意主要的目標。

items.pos: n. 椅子；主席 | v. 主持
items.colloc: office chair 辦公椅 | chair a meeting 主持會議
items.distinct: seat 座位 | moderator 主持人
ex: She will chair the meeting tomorrow morning.
她將主持明天早上的會議。
Please replace the broken office chair.
請更換那張壞掉的辦公椅。
Who is going to chair the committee?
誰要擔任委員會的主席？
